WITH pub AS (
  SELECT cdscode, county, district, doctype, admfname1, admfname2, admfname3
  FROM schools
  WHERE county IN ('Amador','Madera')
    AND doctype IN ('Unified School District','Elementary School District','High School District','County Office of Education (COE)')
),
names AS (
  SELECT 'Stacy'::text AS fname UNION ALL SELECT 'Avetik'
),
dists AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT county, district FROM pub WHERE district IS NOT NULL
),
hits AS (
  SELECT p.county, p.district, n.fname, p.cdscode
  FROM pub p
  CROSS JOIN names n
  WHERE n.fname IN (p.admfname1, p.admfname2, p.admfname3)
)
SELECT d.district AS "District Name", n.fname AS "First Name", COUNT(DISTINCT h.cdscode) AS "School Count"
FROM dists d
CROSS JOIN names n
LEFT JOIN hits h ON h.county = d.county AND h.district = d.district AND h.fname = n.fname
GROUP BY d.district, n.fname
ORDER BY d.district, n.fname;

WITH active AS (
  SELECT s.cdscode, s.fundingtype
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.charter = 1 AND s.statustype = 'Active'
    AND s.fundingtype IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
),
fr AS (
  SELECT a.fundingtype, f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enr, f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS pct
  FROM active a
  LEFT JOIN frpm f ON f.cdscode = a.cdscode AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
),
sat AS (
  SELECT a.cdscode, a.fundingtype, (x.avgscrread + x.avgscrmath + x.avgscrwrite) AS combined
  FROM active a
  JOIN satscores x ON x.cds = a.cdscode
  WHERE x.avgscrread IS NOT NULL AND x.avgscrmath IS NOT NULL AND x.avgscrwrite IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  a.fundingtype AS "Funding Category",
  (SELECT count(*) FROM active b WHERE b.fundingtype = a.fundingtype) AS "Active Charter Schools",
  (SELECT sum(fr.enr) FROM fr WHERE fr.fundingtype = a.fundingtype) AS "Total 2014-2015 K-12 Enrollment",
  (SELECT round((avg(fr.pct) * 100)::numeric, 2) FROM fr WHERE fr.fundingtype = a.fundingtype) AS "Avg FRPM Eligibility Percent",
  (SELECT round(avg(sat.combined)::numeric, 2) FROM sat WHERE sat.fundingtype = a.fundingtype) AS "Avg Combined SAT Score"
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT fundingtype FROM active) a
ORDER BY a.fundingtype

WITH base AS (
  SELECT s.school AS school_name,
         ROUND((f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)")::numeric, 4) AS free_meal_rate,
         f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS raw_rate,
         CASE WHEN s.charter = 1 THEN 'Yes' WHEN s.charter = 0 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS charter_school,
         s.gsserved AS grades_served,
         sat.avgscrread, sat.avgscrmath, sat.avgscrwrite
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
  LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = f.cdscode
  WHERE s.county = 'Alameda'
    AND s.gsserved LIKE '%12'
    AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
),
top AS (
  SELECT * FROM base WHERE raw_rate = (SELECT MAX(raw_rate) FROM base)
)
SELECT school_name,
       free_meal_rate,
       charter_school,
       grades_served,
       CASE
         WHEN avgscrread IS NULL OR avgscrmath IS NULL OR avgscrwrite IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
         WHEN avgscrread + avgscrmath + avgscrwrite < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
         WHEN avgscrread + avgscrmath + avgscrwrite <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
         ELSE 'Above Average'
       END AS sat_performance_level
FROM top;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT f.cdscode, f."School Name" AS school, s.county, s.city, s.mailstreet, s.mailcity, s.mailstate, s.mailzip, s.website,
         f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enr, f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm,
         f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS share,
         t.avgscrread, t.avgscrmath, t.avgscrwrite, t.numtsttakr, t.numge1500, s.opendate, s.closeddate
  FROM frpm f
  LEFT JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
  LEFT JOIN satscores t ON t.cds = f.cdscode
  WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 0 AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 100
),
maxc AS (SELECT max(frpm) m FROM base),
mins AS (SELECT min(share) m FROM base),
parts AS (
  SELECT 'largest FRPM-eligible count' AS label, b.* FROM base b, maxc WHERE b.frpm = maxc.m
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'smallest FRPM share', b.* FROM base b, mins WHERE b.share = mins.m
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'the CDS code from my notes', b.* FROM base b WHERE b.cdscode = '04615150435602'
)
SELECT label, school AS "School Name", county AS "County", city AS "City",
       mailstreet AS "Mailing Street", mailcity AS "Mailing City", mailstate AS "Mailing State", mailzip AS "Mailing ZIP",
       website AS "Website", enr AS "K-12 Enrollment", frpm AS "FRPM Count", share AS "FRPM Share",
       (avgscrread + avgscrmath + avgscrwrite) AS "Avg Total SAT",
       CASE WHEN numtsttakr > 0 THEN 100.0 * numge1500 / numtsttakr END AS "Pct SAT 1500+",
       opendate AS "Open Date",
       CASE WHEN closeddate IS NOT NULL THEN 'closed' ELSE 'open' END AS "Status"
FROM parts
ORDER BY CASE label WHEN 'largest FRPM-eligible count' THEN 1 WHEN 'smallest FRPM share' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, cdscode

counts AS (
  SELECT s.language, COUNT(fd.id) AS printings
  FROM st_langs s
  LEFT JOIN foreign_data fd

   AND fd.flavortext IS NOT NULL

  GROUP BY s.language
),
mn AS (SELECT MIN(printings) AS m FROM counts)

FROM counts c, mn
WHERE c.printings = mn.m
ORDER BY c.language;

  SELECT c.segment,
         sum(CASE WHEN substr(y.date,1,4)='2012' THEN y.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2012,
         sum(CASE WHEN substr(y.date,1,4)='2013' THEN y.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2013

  JOIN customers c ON c.customerid = y.customerid
  WHERE c.currency = 'EUR' AND c.segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM')

  FROM s WHERE c2012 <> 0

WITH home_wins AS (
  SELECT m.id, m.date, m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id
  FROM match m
  WHERE m.home_team_goal - m.away_team_goal >= 3
),
fast_wins AS (
  SELECT hw.team_api_id
  FROM home_wins hw
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ta.buildupplayspeedclass
    FROM team_attributes ta
    WHERE ta.team_api_id = hw.team_api_id
      AND ta.date <= hw.date
    ORDER BY ta.date DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) r
  WHERE r.buildupplayspeedclass = 'Fast'
),
counts AS (
  SELECT team_api_id, COUNT(*) AS wins
  FROM fast_wins
  GROUP BY team_api_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT c.team_api_id, c.wins, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.wins DESC) AS rk
  FROM counts c
)
SELECT t.team_long_name AS club_name, t.team_short_name AS short_name, r.wins AS home_wins
FROM ranked r
JOIN team t ON t.team_api_id = r.team_api_id
WHERE r.rk = 1
ORDER BY t.team_long_name;

LEFT JOIN act ON act.district_id = t.district_id
ORDER BY avg_active_loan_per_account DESC;

WITH pr_loans AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.date AS opened, SUM(l.amount) AS total_borrowed
  FROM account a
  JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE a.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE a2 = 'Prachatice')
  GROUP BY a.account_id, a.date
),
owner AS (
  SELECT d.account_id, c.district_id AS home_district_id
  FROM disp d JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
  WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
),
cp AS (
  SELECT t.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.account) AS counterparties
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.operation IN ('PREVOD Z UCTU', 'PREVOD NA UCET')
    AND t.account IS NOT NULL AND t.account <> 0
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT p.account_id, p.opened, p.total_borrowed,
         COALESCE(cp.counterparties, 0) AS counterparties,
         o.home_district_id, dist.a4::bigint AS population
  FROM pr_loans p
  LEFT JOIN cp ON cp.account_id = p.account_id
  LEFT JOIN owner o ON o.account_id = p.account_id
  LEFT JOIN district dist ON dist.district_id = o.home_district_id
)
SELECT account_id, opened, total_borrowed, counterparties, home_district_id, population,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY population DESC) AS population_rank
FROM base
ORDER BY population DESC, account_id ASC

WITH acc AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.date)::int AS yr
  FROM account a
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE d.a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND a.date >= DATE '1996-01-01'
),
accl AS (
  SELECT acc.account_id, acc.district_id, acc.yr, COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS lent
  FROM acc
  LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = acc.account_id
  GROUP BY acc.account_id, acc.district_id, acc.yr
),
dist_avg AS (
  SELECT yr, district_id, SUM(lent)::numeric / COUNT(*) AS avg_lent
  FROM accl
  GROUP BY yr, district_id
),
y AS (
  SELECT yr, COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened, SUM(lent) AS total_lent
  FROM accl
  GROUP BY yr
),
z AS (
  SELECT yr, AVG(avg_lent) AS avg_lent_per_district
  FROM dist_avg
  GROUP BY yr
)
SELECT y.yr::text AS year,
       y.accounts_opened,
       y.total_lent,
       ROUND(z.avg_lent_per_district, 2) AS avg_lent_per_district
FROM y
JOIN z USING (yr)
ORDER BY y.yr;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT district_id, a2, a3, a4::bigint AS pop FROM district WHERE a4::bigint >= 100000
),
w AS (
  SELECT a.district_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total
  FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  GROUP BY a.district_id
),
acc AS (
  SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM account GROUP BY district_id
),
so AS (
  SELECT a.district_id, SUM(o.amount) AS so
  FROM "order" o JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
  WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  GROUP BY a.district_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT d.a2, d.a3, d.pop, w.total,
         ROUND(w.total::numeric / d.pop, 2) AS wpi,
         ROUND(COALESCE(so.so, 0)::numeric / acc.n, 2) AS sopa
  FROM d
  JOIN w ON w.district_id = d.district_id
  JOIN acc ON acc.district_id = d.district_id
  LEFT JOIN so ON so.district_id = d.district_id
)
SELECT a2 AS district_name,
       a3 AS region,
       pop AS population,
       total AS total_withdrawn,
       wpi AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY wpi DESC) AS rank,
       sopa AS avg_standing_order_per_account
FROM base
ORDER BY rank, district_name;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT cl.client_id, cl.gender, cl.birth_date, c.type AS card_type,
         EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.issued)::int - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cl.birth_date)::int AS age_at_issue,
         a.account_id, cl.district_id
  FROM card c
  JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
  JOIN client cl ON cl.client_id = d.client_id
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
  WHERE c.issued >= '1994-01-01' AND c.issued < '1995-01-01'
),
loan_agg AS (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS loan_count, SUM(amount) AS total_amount
  FROM loan GROUP BY account_id
),
joined AS (
  SELECT b.client_id, b.gender, b.birth_date, b.card_type, b.age_at_issue,
         COALESCE(la.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
         COALESCE(la.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount,
         b.district_id
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN loan_agg la ON la.account_id = b.account_id
)
SELECT j.client_id, j.gender, j.birth_date, j.card_type, j.age_at_issue,
       j.loan_count, j.total_amount,
       CASE
         WHEN j.loan_count > 0 AND j.age_at_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower'
         WHEN j.loan_count > 0 AND j.age_at_issue >= 30 THEN 'Mature borrower'
         ELSE 'Non-borrower'
       END AS borrower_classification,
       di.a2 AS district_name,
       di.a11 AS district_avg_salary,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY j.gender ORDER BY j.age_at_issue) AS age_rank_within_gender
FROM joined j
LEFT JOIN district di ON di.district_id = j.district_id
ORDER BY j.client_id

WITH cl AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
  FROM disp d WHERE d.client_id = 3541
),
home AS (SELECT district_id FROM client WHERE client_id = 3541),
rg AS (
  SELECT dt.district_id, dt.a2, dt.a3, dt.a4::bigint AS pop, dt.a11
  FROM district dt
),
regcnt AS (
  SELECT dt.a3, COUNT(c.client_id) AS region_clients
  FROM client c JOIN district dt ON dt.district_id = c.district_id
  GROUP BY dt.a3
),
topd AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (a3) a3, a2 AS top_name, pop AS top_pop
  FROM rg ORDER BY a3, pop DESC, district_id
),
ranks AS (
  SELECT district_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY pop DESC) AS pop_rank FROM rg
),
tx AS (
  SELECT account_id,
    COUNT(*) AS n_tx,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount END), 0) AS income,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount END), 0) AS expense
  FROM trans GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
  a.account_id,
  a.date AS open_date,
  a.frequency,
  rg.a2 AS district_name,
  rg.a3 AS region,
  CASE WHEN a.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM home) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_home_district,
  rg.a11 AS avg_salary,
  COALESCE(l.status, 'none') AS loan_status,
  COALESCE(l.amount, 0) AS loan_amount,
  COALESCE(tx.n_tx, 0) AS num_transactions,
  COALESCE(tx.income, 0) AS total_income,
  COALESCE(tx.expense, 0) AS total_expense,
  COALESCE(tx.income, 0) - COALESCE(tx.expense, 0) AS net_balance,
  COALESCE(rc.region_clients, 0) AS region_client_count,
  topd.top_name AS most_populous_district,
  topd.top_pop AS most_populous_pop,
  rk.pop_rank AS population_rank_in_region
FROM cl
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = cl.account_id
JOIN rg ON rg.district_id = a.district_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN tx ON tx.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN regcnt rc ON rc.a3 = rg.a3
LEFT JOIN topd ON topd.a3 = rg.a3
LEFT JOIN ranks rk ON rk.district_id = rg.district_id
ORDER BY num_transactions DESC, a.account_id ASC

WITH gold AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
  FROM card c JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
  WHERE c.type = 'gold'
),
tt AS (
  SELECT t.account_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS received,
         SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS withdrawn
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM gold)
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
ln AS (
  SELECT l.account_id, COUNT(*) AS loans
  FROM loan l
  WHERE l.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM gold)
  GROUP BY l.account_id
),
cp AS (
  SELECT x.account_id, COUNT(*) AS counterparties
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.account_id, t.bank, t.account
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM gold)
      AND t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.bank <> ''
  ) x
  GROUP BY x.account_id
)
SELECT g.account_id,
       di.a2 AS district_name,
       di.a3 AS region,
       COALESCE(tt.received, 0) AS total_received,
       COALESCE(tt.withdrawn, 0) AS total_withdrawn,
       COALESCE(ln.loans, 0) AS loan_count,
       COALESCE(cp.counterparties, 0) AS external_counterparties,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(cp.counterparties, 0) DESC) AS counterparty_rank
FROM gold g
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = g.account_id
JOIN district di ON di.district_id = a.district_id
LEFT JOIN tt ON tt.account_id = g.account_id
LEFT JOIN ln ON ln.account_id = g.account_id
LEFT JOIN cp ON cp.account_id = g.account_id
ORDER BY counterparty_rank, g.account_id;

WITH fl AS (
  SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.payments, l.duration, l.status, c.client_id, c.birth_date, a.district_id
  FROM loan l
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = l.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
  JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
  WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
top AS (
  SELECT * FROM fl
  WHERE amount >= (SELECT min(amount) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT amount FROM fl ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 3) t)
),
tx AS (
  SELECT account_id, count(*) AS tx_count,
         sum(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS deposits
  FROM trans
  WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM top)
  GROUP BY account_id
),
reg_loans AS (
  SELECT dist.a3 AS region, count(*) AS loan_cnt
  FROM loan l
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  JOIN district dist ON dist.district_id = a.district_id
  GROUP BY dist.a3
),
reg_sal AS (
  SELECT a3 AS region, avg(a11) AS avg_sal
  FROM district
  GROUP BY a3
)
SELECT t.client_id,
       t.amount,
       t.duration,
       round((t.payments * t.duration)::numeric, 2) AS total_payments,
       round((t.payments * t.duration - t.amount)::numeric, 2) AS interest_paid,
       t.status,
       t.district_id,
       d.a3 AS region,
       COALESCE(tx.tx_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
       round(COALESCE(tx.deposits, 0)::numeric, 2) AS total_deposits,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(tx.deposits, 0) > 2 * t.amount THEN 'High Income'
            WHEN COALESCE(tx.deposits, 0) > t.amount THEN 'Medium Income'
            ELSE 'Low Income' END AS income_category,
       rl.loan_cnt AS region_loan_count,
       round(rs.avg_sal::numeric, 2) AS region_avg_salary,
       extract(year from age(DATE '2026-10-09', t.birth_date))::int AS age_2026
FROM top t
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = t.district_id
LEFT JOIN tx ON tx.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN reg_loans rl ON rl.region = d.a3
LEFT JOIN reg_sal rs ON rs.region = d.a3
ORDER BY t.amount DESC

WITH classic_owners AS (
  SELECT d.client_id, d.account_id
  FROM disp d
  JOIN card c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
  WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' AND c.type = 'classic'
),
acct_out AS (
  SELECT t.account_id,
         t.bank, t.account,
         t.amount
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
    AND t.account IS NOT NULL
    AND t.account <> 0
),
dist_stats AS (
  SELECT a.district_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT co.client_id) AS client_cnt,
         COUNT(DISTINCT (ao.bank, ao.account)) AS ext_accounts,
         COALESCE(SUM(ao.amount), 0) AS total_amount
  FROM classic_owners co
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = co.account_id
  LEFT JOIN acct_out ao ON ao.account_id = co.account_id
  GROUP BY a.district_id
)
SELECT di.a2 AS district_name,
       COALESCE(ds.client_cnt, 0) AS classic_client_count,
       COALESCE(ds.ext_accounts, 0) AS external_account_count,
       COALESCE(ds.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount_paid
FROM district di
LEFT JOIN dist_stats ds ON ds.district_id = di.district_id
ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC, district_name ASC

WITH acc AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.date, a.district_id
  FROM account a
  WHERE a.district_id = 21 AND a.date <= DATE '1996-12-31'
),
owner AS (
  SELECT d.account_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
  FROM disp d JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
  WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
),
cards AS (
  SELECT d.account_id, count(*) AS n
  FROM card k JOIN disp d ON d.disp_id = k.disp_id
  WHERE k.issued <= DATE '1996-12-31'
  GROUP BY d.account_id
),
loans AS (
  SELECT account_id, count(*) AS n,
         bool_or(status = 'B') AS any_b,
         bool_or(status IN ('C','D')) AS any_cd
  FROM loan
  WHERE date <= DATE '1996-12-31'
  GROUP BY account_id
),
tr AS (
  SELECT account_id, count(*) AS n,
         sum(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in,
         sum(CASE WHEN type IN ('VYDAJ','VYBER') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out,
         max(balance) AS peak
  FROM trans
  WHERE date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND date <= DATE '1997-12-31'
  GROUP BY account_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.date, o.gender,
         EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(DATE '1996-12-31', o.birth_date))::int AS age,
         COALESCE(c.n, 0) AS card_count,
         COALESCE(l.n, 0) AS loan_count,
         CASE WHEN COALESCE(l.n, 0) = 0 THEN 'no loan'
              WHEN l.any_b THEN 'defaulted'
              WHEN l.any_cd THEN 'repaying'

WITH acc AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.date, a.district_id
  FROM account a
  WHERE a.district_id = 21 AND a.date <= DATE '1996-12-31'
),
owner AS (
  SELECT d.account_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
  FROM disp d JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
  WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
),
cards AS (
  SELECT d.account_id, count(*) AS n
  FROM card k JOIN disp d ON d.disp_id = k.disp_id
  WHERE k.issued <= DATE '1996-12-31'
  GROUP BY d.account_id
),
loans AS (
  SELECT account_id, count(*) AS n,
         bool_or(status = 'B') AS any_b,
         bool_or(status IN ('C','D')) AS any_cd
  FROM loan
  WHERE date <= DATE '1996-12-31'
  GROUP BY account_id
),
tr AS (
  SELECT account_id, count(*) AS n,
         sum(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in,
         sum(CASE WHEN type IN ('VYDAJ','VYBER') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out,
         max(balance) AS peak
  FROM trans
  WHERE date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND date <= DATE '1997-12-31'
  GROUP BY account_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.date, o.gender,
         EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(DATE '1996-12-31', o.birth_date))::int AS age,
         COALESCE(c.n, 0) AS card_count,
         COALESCE(l.n, 0) AS loan_count,
         CASE WHEN COALESCE(l.n, 0) = 0 THEN 'no loan'
              WHEN l.any_b THEN 'defaulted'
              WHEN l.any_cd THEN 'repaying'
              ELSE 'paid off' END AS loan_status,
         COALESCE(t.n, 0) AS trans_count,
         COALESCE(t.money_in, 0) AS money_in,
         COALESCE(t.money_out, 0) AS money_out,
         COALESCE(t.peak, 0) AS peak_balance
  FROM acc a
  LEFT JOIN owner o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
  LEFT JOIN cards c ON c.account_id = a.account_id
  LEFT JOIN loans l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  LEFT JOIN tr t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
)
SELECT account_id,
       date AS account_opened,
       gender,
       age,
       card_count,
       loan_count,
       loan_status,
       trans_count,
       money_in,
       money_out,
       peak_balance,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance DESC) AS peak_balance_rank
FROM base
ORDER BY account_id

counts AS (
  SELECT f.event_id, f.event_name, COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS n
  FROM fall f
  LEFT JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event = f.event_id
  GROUP BY f.event_id, f.event_name
),
ws AS (
  SELECT n FROM counts WHERE event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'
),
avg_fall AS (

       CASE WHEN ws.n > avg_fall.avg_n THEN 'more'

            ELSE 'equal' END AS verdict
FROM ws CROSS JOIN avg_fall

SELECT m.major_name, COUNT(DISTINCT mb.member_id) AS attendee_count
FROM attendance a
JOIN event e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event AND e.event_name = 'Football game'
JOIN member mb ON mb.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN major m ON m.major_id = mb.link_to_major
GROUP BY m.major_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT mb.member_id) = (
  SELECT MAX(c) FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mb2.member_id) AS c
    FROM attendance a2
    JOIN event e2 ON e2.event_id = a2.link_to_event AND e2.event_name = 'Football game'
    JOIN member mb2 ON mb2.member_id = a2.link_to_member
    JOIN major m2 ON m2.major_id = mb2.link_to_major
    GROUP BY m2.major_name
  ) t
)
ORDER BY m.major_name

WITH tz(circuitref, zone) AS (VALUES
 ('red_bull_ring','Europe/Vienna'),('BAK','Asia/Baku'),('bahrain','Asia/Bahrain'),('spa','Europe/Brussels'),
 ('interlagos','America/Sao_Paulo'),('villeneuve','America/Montreal'),('shanghai','Asia/Shanghai'),
 ('magny_cours','Europe/Paris'),('hockenheimring','Europe/Berlin'),('nurburgring','Europe/Berlin'),
 ('hungaroring','Europe/Budapest'),('buddh','Asia/Kolkata'),('imola','Europe/Rome'),('monza','Europe/Rome'),
 ('fuji','Asia/Tokyo'),('suzuka','Asia/Tokyo'),('yeongam','Asia/Seoul'),('sepang','Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'),
 ('rodriguez','America/Mexico_City'),('monaco','Europe/Monaco'),('sochi','Europe/Moscow'),
 ('marina_bay','Asia/Singapore'),('catalunya','Europe/Madrid'),('valencia','Europe/Madrid'),
 ('istanbul','Europe/Istanbul'),('yas_marina','Asia/Dubai'),('silverstone','Europe/London'),
 ('americas','America/Chicago'),('indianapolis','America/New_York')),
loc AS (
 SELECT c.circuitref, ((r.date + r.time::interval) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE tz.zone)::time AS lt
 FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN tz ON tz.circuitref = c.circuitref
 WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL),
ext AS (SELECT MIN(lt) mn, MAX(lt) mx FROM loc)
SELECT
 (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT circuitref, ', ') FROM loc, ext WHERE loc.lt = ext.mn) AS earliest_circuitref,
 (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT circuitref, ', ') FROM loc, ext WHERE loc.lt = ext.mx) AS latest_circuitref,
 EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ext.mx - ext.mn))::bigint AS gap_seconds
FROM ext

WITH member_counts AS (
  SELECT m.member_id,
         CASE WHEN m.position IN ('President','Vice President','Secretary','Treasurer') THEN 'officer' ELSE 'other' END AS grp,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance a WHERE a.link_to_member = m.member_id) AS events_attended
  FROM member m
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN grp = 'officer' THEN events_attended END)::numeric, 2) AS avg_events_per_officer,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN grp = 'other' THEN events_attended END)::numeric, 2) AS avg_events_per_other_student
FROM member_counts

WITH item_counts AS (
  SELECT e.link_to_member, COUNT(DISTINCT lower(trim(x))) AS kinds
  FROM expense e, unnest(string_to_array(e.expense_description, ',')) AS x
  WHERE e.expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND e.expense_date < '2019-12-01'
    AND e.link_to_member IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY e.link_to_member
),
spend AS (
  SELECT link_to_member, SUM(cost) AS total
  FROM expense
  WHERE expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND expense_date < '2019-12-01'
  GROUP BY link_to_member
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT ic.link_to_member, ic.kinds, s.total,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ic.kinds DESC) AS rk
  FROM item_counts ic
  JOIN spend s ON s.link_to_member = ic.link_to_member
)
SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name,
       r.kinds AS kinds_bought,
       ROUND(r.total::numeric, 2) AS total_spent
FROM ranked r
JOIN member m ON m.member_id = r.link_to_member
WHERE r.rk = 1;

  SELECT id FROM patient
  WHERE (SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT t ORDER BY t) FROM unnest(regexp_split_to_array(trim(diagnosis), '[ ,]+')) t) = ARRAY['RA','SJS']
),
flags AS (
  SELECT c.id, COALESCE(bool_or(l.plt > 100 AND l.plt < 400), false) AS has_normal
  FROM cand c LEFT JOIN laboratory l ON l.id = c.id
  GROUP BY c.id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_normal) AS with_normal_plt,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT has_normal) AS never_normal_plt
FROM flags

GROUP BY admission
ORDER BY care_setting;

WITH cmol AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'c'
),
atom_stats AS (
  SELECT molecule_id,
         COUNT(*) AS n_atoms,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'c') AS n_carbon,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'cl') AS n_chlorine
  FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id
),
bond_stats AS (
  SELECT b.molecule_id,
         COUNT(*) AS n_bonds,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS n_multiple,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
            WHERE c.bond_id = b.bond_id AND a.element = 'c')) AS n_carbon_bonds
  FROM bond b GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label,
         COALESCE(s.n_atoms, 0) AS n_atoms,
         COALESCE(bs.n_bonds, 0) AS n_bonds,
         COALESCE(s.n_carbon, 0) AS n_carbon,
         COALESCE(s.n_chlorine, 0) AS n_chlorine,
         COALESCE(bs.n_carbon_bonds, 0) AS n_carbon_bonds,
         COALESCE(bs.n_multiple, 0) AS n_multiple
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN cmol cm ON cm.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN atom_stats s ON s.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN bond_stats bs ON bs.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
)
SELECT DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY n_carbon_bonds DESC, n_atoms DESC, molecule_id ASC) AS rank,
       molecule_id, label, n_atoms, n_bonds, n_carbon, n_chlorine, n_carbon_bonds, n_multiple
FROM base
ORDER BY rank, molecule_id

         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
            WHERE c.bond_id = b.bond_id AND a.element = 'c')) AS n_carbon_bonds
  FROM bond b GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label,
         COALESCE(s.n_atoms, 0) AS n_atoms,
         COALESCE(bs.n_bonds, 0) AS n_bonds,
         COALESCE(s.n_carbon, 0) AS n_carbon,
         COALESCE(s.n_chlorine, 0) AS n_chlorine,
         COALESCE(bs.n_carbon_bonds, 0) AS n_carbon_bonds,
         COALESCE(bs.n_multiple, 0) AS n_multiple
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN cmol cm ON cm.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN atom_stats s ON s.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN bond_stats bs ON bs.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
)
SELECT DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY n_carbon_bonds DESC, n_atoms DESC, molecule_id ASC) AS rank,
       molecule_id, label, n_atoms, n_bonds, n_carbon, n_chlorine, n_carbon_bonds, n_multiple
FROM base
ORDER BY rank, molecule_id
